ns2:section.sectionText: This course studies theory and measurement of efficiency costs of taxation, tax incidence, optimal commodity taxation, optimal income taxation, the theory of tax design, in-kind transfers, taxation of externalities, taxation and labor supply, tax evasion, and optimal provision of public goods in a second-best setting. Then we turn to dynamic settings and study the effects of taxation on savings and capital accumulation as well as revisiting incidence and optimal tax issues. In this context, the competing frameworks of dynastic families and overlapping-generations will both be studied.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics department.
